evidence.title: AI Image Prompts — 10,000+ Curated Prompts for Any Model
AI Image Prompts — Universal Prompt Recommender

name: AI Image Prompts
summary: Agent skill that searches 10,000+ curated image generation prompts and returns top matches with sample images.
description: A SKILL.md package for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other assistants: it searches a library of 10,000+ community-curated image prompts across 11 use-case categories and recommends up to three matches with their sample images, or remixes a prompt around your own content. The prompt references sync from GitHub twice daily.
contains: 10,000+ prompts in 11 categories (social media, product, avatar, poster, e-commerce, game, comic, thumbnail)
every prompt includes its sample image
two modes: direct search and content-illustration remix
references auto-update from GitHub twice daily
installs in OpenClaw, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI
model-agnostic: Nano Banana, Seedream, GPT Image, Midjourney, DALL-E, Flux, Stable Diffusion
